BCHE 2910.attendance: Attendance is taken daily; full attendance marks need attending and actively participating in more than 80% of class sessions (20 or more), and attendance is required on exam days.
BCHE 2910.lateWork: Homework due 11:59 PM is accepted without penalty until 8:00 AM the next morning; excused late homework is accepted only in extreme circumstances such as a personal crisis.
BCHE 2910.makeups: Exam attendance is mandatory except in an emergency or personal crisis; no make-up process is described.

objectives: Students will learn basic biochemical engineering concepts.
Students will learn about biochemical engineering processes, including process flow sheets, process units, and their functions.
Students will understand the stepwise methodology to solve material balance problems.
Students will understand degree of freedom analysis for solving material balance problems.
Students will be able to solve material balance problems in biochemical engineering process for single and multiple process units.
Students will be able to solve energy balance problems with and without a chemical reaction.
Students will understand the basics of biochemical process design.
Students will generate process flow sheets for a given biochemical engineering design process.

Students will acknowledge applications of process control in biological systems and be aware of the need for life-long learning.
